rationale: Asymmetric semantic join: the image side has a nameable slot (logo_brand); the airline side is already structured. Extract one side, then hash-join.

attributes.name: logo_brand
attributes.description: Brand/company whose logo the image shows
attributes.extract_instruction: Identify the brand or company whose logo appears in the image; if none, output 'none'.

attributes.name: ocr_text
attributes.description: Any text visible in the logo (backstop for fuzzy matching)
attributes.extract_instruction: Transcribe any text visible in the logo.

rules: strip suffix {air lines, airlines, airways, airline, air}
normalization.note: Alias/abbreviation reconciliation is the hidden difficulty; built once at compile time.

residual.action: run original AI.IF(airline, image) only for unsure images against candidate airlines
